logical.byte_bit_rule: v3 b_S=b_R=1 means Byte/element, not 1-bit arithmetic. Encoded copies add physical occupancy, never logical payload.

physical.mode: SLC SGVC split-sign magnitude current-sum ACIM,base4 approximate signed INT8
physical.weight_SSL_code: LSB once,MSB twice;positive/negative magnitudes use distinct blocks
physical.resident_publish: atomic whole matrix after all page verify and reference calibration
physical.resident_encoding_lifecycle: Invalidate matrix;stream one output row through16 signed-to-magnitude lanes into4608x9bit staging;format24 physical data pages at48 useful encoded bits/beat through128bit nominal port;release staging after row programs;publish only after all blocks/pages and reference calibration pass;no whole-matrix shadow
physical.precision_contract: approximate signed sums;nominal count resolution remains finite

neurosim_array_assignment.rule: Never substitute logical K,N for a physical array; preserve native banks, plane orientation, active rows, isolation and access direction.

physical.access_direction: 64 native blocks;32 WL/block;3 SSL/WL;13824 bitline page;30 data and2 calibration WL;positive/negative magnitude blocks; four base4 digits; LSB once/MSB twice; three input copies.

device.native_technology_policy: Retain native device bias/load/geometry independently of the low-voltage peripheral technology; no 28nm Technology table or enum relabeling.

normal_evaluation.operation: 1152 logical terms;two input-sign BL phases;four base4 input digits;separate positive/negative weight magnitude blocks
normal_evaluation.load: native SL approximately16 pF; fixed0-25uA current frontend
normal_evaluation.endpoint: ADC sample after conditional SL settling; approximate partial sum
normal_evaluation.source_qualification: NAND-04 p.3 Table1 HSPICE max-bit mapping; group selection is a reference bridge,not measured at1152 terms

load_calibration.operation: zero/full reference WL;zero/full/half input at each of4 groups
load_calibration.load: same SL,group selection,current frontend and ADC
load_calibration.endpoint: two-point gain/offset plus half-input residual<=4 nominal ADC codes;reference full magnitude code remains legal physical calibration pattern
load_calibration.source_qualification: NAND-05 p.2 II(e),p.4 Fig.12;finite schedule and threshold are declared reference choices

page_program_verify.operation: native PB controls two-state threshold program/verify and return-to-ready
page_program_verify.bias: program/verify internal WL/BL bias;not normal SL MAC bias
page_program_verify.load: native page buffer and internal verify sense path
page_program_verify.endpoint: valid high/low Vt states plus successful page status;ON platform and subsequent SL calibration are separate conditions
page_program_verify.source_qualification: NAND-04 p.2 II-A says both states use write-verify to fine-tune Vt;NAND-05 pp.2-3 Fig.6 uses SLC distribution and saturated ON;NAND-06 pp.25,31,58 is only cross-implementation complete P/E timing

native_electrical_parameter_policy.fallback: retain native complete service or stated primitive; never silently use upstream default device/load

program_verify.status: native full page service includes internal bias,program,verify,recovery; no generic string/RC substitution

clock.rule: actual=max(target_period_ns, measured used sensing/combinational critical path); DFF alone does not prove closure

periphery.scope: Low-voltage peripheral candidates only; native array/driver/sense complete services retain their original load and bias.

native_declared.actual_write_domain: one native page program domain with PB inhibit/verify

resources.capacity_policy: Installed capacity is not active parallelism. No extra ADC, SA, hold bank, driver or mux lane may appear without a resource edit.

mux_scope.rule: Ratios express selected outputs/local addresses; native row/layer/CIMSEL decoding is separate. No switch capacitance or RC assumed from fanin alone.

unresolved.reason: Native NAND WL/SSL/SL organization and full page/block engine have no validated substitute in generic NeuroSim NVM. Native current front is preserved; ADC/digital replacement must also propagate to load calibration.

implementation_plan.code_generation: No full NAND matrix and no model/dataset download.
comparison_only_modules: ShiftAdd: internal DFF/read-pulse capacity and overlap require separate proof
implementation_plan.next: Root integrates source probes and pins coverage decisions before Step 3.
implementation_plan.no_double_counting: Native opaque stages exclude replacement charges for their included stages. For constituent-mode stages, charge only listed primitives; calculator function is provenance, not a command to add its total again.

service_schedules.semantics: Ordered loops; execute each nested stage before advancing the enclosing group/attempt. Top-level flat dependencies must not globally reorder phases. Zero new payload in maintenance.
